title: Object Selection and Compute Collision Shape aren't working properly after re-importing a GLB file
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6119) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)

### Issue description

One morning, within the same hour I experienced these two issues:
- everything just seemed broken, random objects would be selected when I click on an object;
- the Mesh>Create Collision Shape was creating collision shape for a previous version of my level;

While I was trying to replicate these issues for this bug report, I realised that both issues were related. 


### Steps to reproduce

Took me a while to understand what was happening and replicate but here we are:
- import a GLB file containing a  mesh in Godot
- Select the mesh (no problem), compute the collision shape with Mesh>Create Collision Shape (everything is fine)
- Go in blender, and in edit mode, move the vertex of the mesh
- export/re-import the GLB file
- Select the mesh in the Inspector, compute the collision shape with Mesh>Create Collision Shape
- Expected Issues:
   - Collision Shape is computed for previous version of the mesh
   - Try to click on the mesh, you will see that the selection also use the previous version of the mesh

I took a video:
https://youtu.be/8hJNFo94Fec

Here the selection issue (although you need to guess when I clicked):
https://youtu.be/Bw57yB2soBA
